title: Art Crate Breach
description: A weathered wooden crate labeled 'ART CRASZ STUDIO - 2020' floats at the center of a shattered glass portal. A monstrous clawed creature with green skin, red accents and dripping hands emerges from the bottom left, reaching toward the crate.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring an old wooden shipping crate labeled 'ART CRASZ STUDIO - 2020' floating in the center of a circular shattered glass portal with sharp glass shards. A grotesque green-skinned monster with red mechanical elements and dripping claws emerges from the bottom left, reaching up toward the crate. Purple and orange swirling energy, dramatic rim lighting, eerie atmosphere, cinematic composition.
